# Frontiers

> > Frontiers is a peer-reviewed open access publisher democratizing scientific research through collaborative publishing, research integrity, and institutional partnerships.

Frontiers is a leading open access publisher founded by Henry and Kamila Markram at EPFL, Switzerland. The organization publishes peer-reviewed articles across multidisciplinary journals with a focus on innovation, research integrity, and open science collaboration.

## Key Topics

- Open Access Publishing
- Peer Review
- Research Integrity
- Creative Commons CC-BY License
- Article Processing Charges
- Institutional Partnerships
- FAIR Data Management

## About Frontiers

- [Frontiers Homepage](https://www.frontiersin.org): Frontiers homepage: open access publisher of peer-reviewed scientific articles
- [Mission](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/mission): Frontiers mission statement: making science open for collaboration and innovation
- [History](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/history): Frontiers founding story by Henry and Kamila Markram at EPFL
- [Leadership](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/leadership): Frontiers leadership team and executive bios including CEO Kamila Markram
- [Awards & Recognition](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/awards): Frontiers awards and recognition including EU Prize for Women Innovators
- [Collaborators & Partnerships](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/collaborators): Frontiers accreditations, memberships, and partnerships with publishing bodies

## Publishing Standards & Integrity

- [How We Publish](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/how-we-publish): Frontiers publishing process: peer-review, open access, researcher-centric model
- [Peer Review](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/peer-review): Frontiers collaborative peer review process with rigorous quality standards
- [Research Integrity](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/research-integrity): Frontiers research integrity: peer review, AI checks, fraud detection, ethics
- [Research Topics](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/research-topics): Frontiers Research Topics: peer-reviewed collections on cutting-edge themes
- [Impact & Metrics](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/impact): Frontiers impact metrics: Journal Impact Factor, CiteScore, citations data

## Open Access & Publishing Model

- [Open Access](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/open-access): Frontiers gold open access model with CC-BY licensing and article fees
- [Fee Policy](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/fee-policy): Frontiers article processing charges, pricing, and fee discounts
- [Institutional Partnerships](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/open-access-agreements): Frontiers institutional partnerships and flat-fee open access agreements
- [Consortia Agreements](https://www.frontiersin.org/open-access-agreements/consortia): Frontiers consortia agreements with institutions for open access publishing

## Data Management & Resources

- [FAIR² Data Management](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/fair-data-management): Frontiers FAIR² Data Management: data curation, publication, visualization

- [Thought Leadership](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/thought-leadership): Frontiers reports, whitepapers on innovation, open science, and sustainability
